title: Cargo scripts ignore frontmatter when the file starts with a UTF-8 BOM
author: phr4nky
body_preview: ### Problem  Unlike `rustc`, Cargo's `ScriptSource::parse` does not skip a leading UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) before parsing the shebang or frontmatter of a Rust script.  As a result, embedded manifests are silently ignored when script files are saved with a BOM.
